ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: This course surveys essential developments in Western Civilization from Antiquity through 1660. It focuses on the evolution of politics, ideas and religious beliefs, and social structures and conflicts. This course examines the contributions of successive and interacting civilizations from the early empires of Mesopotamia to the European colonization of the New World, including the Egyptians, Babylonians, Greeks, Romans, Medieval Europe and the Islamic world. In the process, students gain a new understanding of the cultural fusions and conflicts that continue to define, and challenge, the West and the wider world.
